package.name: l4_bridge
package.description: QuadRover planner bridge (L4): SUPER's and the track planner's commands to MAVROS Guided setpoints (frame anchor, speed cap, geofence, drive targets, reverse, stale-FC-pose hold, planner-death latch), and FAST-LIO's output to the planner frame. The planner_bridge node and its core library. C++ port of the former planner/bridge_core.py and planner_bridge.py.
